joshua.2.p1.b1.text: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim,

joshua.2.p1.b3.text: So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.

joshua.2.p2.b4.text: “Behold, some men of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.”

joshua.2.p2.b5.text: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab and said,

joshua.2.p2.b6.text: “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to spy out the whole land.”

joshua.2.p3.b7.text: “Yes, the men did come to me, but I did not know where they had come from. … Pursue them quickly, and you may catch them!”

joshua.2.p3.b8.text: But Rahab had taken them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax that she had laid out there.

joshua.2.p3.b9.text: So the king’s men set out in pursuit of the spies along the road to the fords of the Jordan,

joshua.2.p3.b10.text: and as soon as they had gone out, the gate was shut.

joshua.2.p4.b11.text: Before the spies lay down for the night, Rahab went up on the roof

joshua.2.p4.b12.text: “I know that the LORD has given you this land and that the fear of you has fallen on us,

joshua.2.p4.b13.text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, …

joshua.2.p4.b14.text: When we heard this, our hearts melted … for the LORD your God is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.

joshua.2.p5.b15.text: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD that you will indeed show kindness to my family, because I showed kindness to you. Give me a sure sign

joshua.2.p5.b16.text: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and that you will deliver us from death.”

joshua.2.p5.b17.text: “Our lives for your lives! … If you do not report our mission, we will show you kindness and faithfulness when the LORD gives us the land.”

joshua.2.p7.b21.text: when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down,

joshua.2.p7.b22.text: and unless you have brought your father and mother and brothers and all your family into your house.

joshua.2.p7.b24.text: and she sent them away. And when they had gone, she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

joshua.2.p8.b25.text: So the spies went out into the hill country and stayed there three days, until their pursuers had returned without finding them, having searched all along the road.

joshua.2.p8.b26.text: Then the two men started back, came down from the hill country, and crossed the river. So they came to Joshua son of Nun …

joshua.2.p8.b27.text: “The LORD has surely delivered the entire land into our hands … Indeed, all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of us.”

joshua.2.p6.b18.text: Then Rahab let them down by a rope through the window,

joshua.2.p6.b19.text: since the house where she lived was built into the wall of the city.

joshua.2.p6.b20.text: “Go to the hill country … so that your pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned; then go on your way.”
